name: Open Sesame
desc: You can use the Charm skill when using the Take Over hacking action. Additionally, you can use the Tap into Resonance maneuver to add [[w]] to such Charm checks.

name: Skinlink
desc: As a maneuver, you can touch a device you are Engaged with to upgrade the ability of your next Hacking skill check once. If the device is held by an adversary, or is able to defend itself against being touched, you make a Brawl combat check against the target as part of the Skinlink maneuver.

name: Resonance Spike
desc: Commit [[p]] from your Resonance dice pool; until the end of the encounter, you can use your Willpower characteristic instead of Intellect for determining the dice pool and base damage of your Data Spike matrix actions, and if you do, you can add [[w]] to those rolls.

name: Resonatic Cybercompatibility
desc: As a maneuver, you can commit an amount of [[p]] up to your Willpower from your Resonance dice pool; you may choose an amount of bodytech whose essence loss is lower or equal to the amount of [[p]] committed, and ignore all penalties towards your Resonance skill checks due to essence loss caused by the chosen implants.

name: Smartlink
desc: You can suffer two strain and commit [[p]] from your Resonance dice pool; until the end of the encounter, you gain the base benefits of the Smartlink bodytech implant.

name: Resonatic Cybercompatibility (Improved)
desc: You can ignore up to two additional points of Essence loss due to bodytech when using the Resonatic Cybercompatibility complex form.
